_quote_cap: Words per quotation, Covenstead's reason: a handful of named passages the room is about. Raise it on purpose, never to fit one passage.

quotes.said: Shade tolerance is not a property of the plant. It is a property of the plant and the place, and it changes when the place does.
The plants take the light the panel does not want. The panel takes the heat the plants do not want. Neither one is the host.
There is no unsuitable crop. There is a ratio nobody adjusted.

This practice, also known as agrivoltaics or dual-use solar, involves locating agricultural production, such as crops, livestock, or pollinator habitats, underneath solar panels or between rows of solar panels.

We found increases over time for all habitat and biodiversity metrics: floral rank, flowering plant species richness, insect group diversity, native bee abundance, and total insect abundance, with the most noticeable temporal increases in native bee abundance.
In January of 2020, before COVID lockdown, we (a Stimpunks family) signed on a solar plus battery system for our home.

_crops: What grows under the panels, the brief's peppers and the other plants that do well there. Every crop names the source its sentence about the shade comes from, and the tool refuses one that does not, and any figure for how much shade a panel casts: a percentage of shade is not in the paper the peppers come from, and the zine that read the paper says so.

crops.name: Chiltepin peppers
crops.shade: In the field under panels outside Tucson, chiltepin made three times the fruit it made in the open, and took up a third more carbon.
crops.to: the café in the old dairy, and the honesty box

crops.name: Jalapeños
crops.shade: Under the same panels, jalapeños made about as much fruit as in the open, with 65 per cent less transpirational water loss. The watering was the same; the plants lost less of it.
crops.to: the café in the old dairy, and the honesty box

crops.name: Cherry tomatoes
crops.shade: Cherry tomatoes made twice the fruit under the panels that they made in the open. In a greenhouse in Michigan, short of light rather than of water, shading cost them fruit instead: what is scarce decides it.
crops.to: the café in the old dairy, and the honesty box

crops.name: Basil
crops.shade: Basil stops using more light past a point well below full sun, so the light the panel takes is light the basil had no use for.
crops.to: the café in the old dairy

panels.cooler: The panels over the crops in that field ran about 8.9 degrees Celsius cooler in daylight than panels over bare ground, and the soil under them stayed wetter.
